sentences.text: Emergency.
Yes.
These are the untold [music] stories of the ER.
sentences.zh: 这些是急诊室不为人知的故事。

sentences.text: Emergency.
They're bringing in a young male with [music] altered mental status and it's probably secondary to alcohol, but we're not sure if he's got something else on board.
sentences.zh: 他们送来一位年轻男性，精神状态改变，可能继发于酒精，但我们不确定他是否还摄入了其他东西。

sentences.text: Whee!
Oh, fun.
I see the back of a young male.
sentences.zh: 我看到一位年轻男性的背影。

sentences.text: He's overly exuberant.
He's speaking very freely with passersby that are walking through the ER.
sentences.zh: 他非常随意地与经过急诊室的路人交谈。

sentences.text: Put on your party hat.
He's too jovial.
He's too happy to be in an emergency room.
sentences.zh: 他太高兴了，以至于在急诊室里。

sentences.text: >> Oh, I love what you've done with the place and the pink curtains.
sentences.zh: 哦，我喜欢你布置的这个房间和粉色窗帘。

sentences.text: Are those for me?
So, as I walk over to the patient's room, uh from the back he looks like a normal, robust, healthy-appearing male, but as I walk to the foot of his bed and I [music] notice his face against the white
sentences.zh: 所以，当我走到病人房间时，从背后看他像一个正常、强壮、看起来健康的男性，但当我走到他床尾时，我注意到他的脸在白色担架背景的映衬下，

sentences.text: backdrop of the stretcher, I notice he's blue.
He's not of this earth color blue.
sentences.zh: 他不是那种地球颜色的蓝。

sentences.text: I don't think it's just the alcohol that's making him do this.
sentences.zh: 我不认为只是酒精让他变成这样。

sentences.text: What's with the funny look, Doc?
sentences.zh: 医生，这奇怪的表情是怎么回事？

sentences.text: There's something else going on.
This guy looks like a Smurf.
sentences.zh: 这家伙看起来像蓝精灵。

sentences.text: [music] Hi, Dr. Beckletter.
Oh.
Going to help you tonight.
Thanks, Doc.
I'm Tad.
It would be a real help if you were able to come closer.
sentences.zh: 如果你能靠近一点，那真是帮了大忙。

sentences.text: Come on closer.
>> Sure.
A little closer.
I'm concerned because he's blue.
sentences.zh: 我很担心，因为他脸色发青。

sentences.text: Probably cyanotic.
What cyanotic [music] means is that he's got something going on that's making his tissues uh deprived of oxygen.
sentences.zh: 发绀的意思是，他体内发生了某种情况，导致他的组织缺氧。

sentences.text: Oh, I'm I'm blue.
Doctor, I why am I blue?
sentences.zh: 医生，我为什么是蓝色的？

sentences.text: How how did I get blue?
This is what we're going to try to figure out, Tad.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们要弄清楚的，塔德。

sentences.text: Oh, this is so not a good color for me.
sentences.zh: 哦，这颜色对我来说真不好看。

sentences.text: Not at all.
>> No, this isn't a good color for anyone.
sentences.zh: 不，这对谁来说都不是好颜色。

sentences.text: Has this ever happened to you before?
sentences.zh: 你以前发生过这种情况吗？

sentences.text: Oh, no.
Do you take any medications regularly?
sentences.zh: 你平时有规律地服用什么药物吗？

sentences.text: No.
Could you have ingested anything tonight?
sentences.zh: 你今晚可能摄入了什么东西吗？

sentences.text: >> No.
No.
No.
No.
You are making me sound so negative.
I'm not negative.
I'm not.
Oh.
Honey, I love your nails.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，我喜欢你的指甲。

sentences.text: But, you know what would really make them pop?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道什么能让它们更出彩吗？

sentences.text: A smile.
You know how to smile?
At this point, the patient is being overly flirtatious with the staff.
sentences.zh: 此时，病人对工作人员表现得过于轻浮。

sentences.text: And, he's commenting on people's nails, eye shadow, color of their scrubs.
sentences.zh: 而且，他还在评论人们的指甲、眼影、工作服的颜色。

sentences.text: He smells of alcohol, but I've smelled patients with much worse alcohol on their breath in the past.
sentences.zh: 他身上有酒味，但我以前闻过比这严重得多的酒气。

sentences.text: On examination, his pupils are big, dilated, kind of darting around.
sentences.zh: 检查时，他的瞳孔很大、散开，有点四处乱转。

sentences.text: Let's get him on a monitor, chest x-ray, EKG, labs, the works.
sentences.zh: 给他上监护仪、胸部X光、心电图、化验，全套检查。

sentences.text: We put him on a cardiac monitor, and put him on an oxygen saturation monitor.
sentences.zh: 我们给他上了心脏监护仪和血氧饱和度监护仪。

sentences.text: >> His sats are low, >> [music] >> 92.
sentences.zh: >> 他的血氧饱和度很低，>> [音乐] >> 92。

sentences.text: This guy's not getting enough oxygen.
Let's get that chest x-ray stat.
I got to see what's going on with his lungs.
sentences.zh: 我得看看他的肺部情况。

sentences.text: I'll call for the portable.
If there's a mass, if there's a pneumothorax, if there's some abnormality to the shape of his heart, that could be contributing [music] to this.
sentences.zh: 如果有肿块、气胸或心脏形状异常，都可能导致这种情况。

sentences.text: His oxygen saturation just still keeps dropping.
sentences.zh: 他的血氧饱和度还在持续下降。

sentences.text: And, I'm concerned because cyanosis [music] could lead to anoxia, and it could lead to what's called anoxic brain injury.
sentences.zh: 而且，我担心因为发绀可能导致缺氧，进而引发所谓的缺氧性脑损伤。

sentences.text: >> How you feeling, Ted?
Never felt better, [music] Doc.
Although, I could use another cocktail.
sentences.zh: 不过，我还能再来一杯鸡尾酒。

sentences.text: But then again, so could nurse smiley over here.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，那边微笑的护士也能来一杯。

sentences.text: If you deprive the brain of oxygen for too long, you can have serious detrimental [music] effects to um neurologic function.
sentences.zh: 如果大脑缺氧时间过长，可能会对神经功能造成严重的负面影响。

sentences.text: Uh doctor, the heart rate's starting to go up.
sentences.zh: 呃，医生，心率开始上升了。

sentences.text: Let's get that portable chest x-ray.
sentences.zh: 我们来做一下便携式胸部X光。

sentences.text: He was a bit tachycardic when he came [music] in, meaning his pulse was high.
sentences.zh: 他进来时有点心动过速，也就是说他的脉搏很快。

sentences.text: Uh so there was something going on, but then all of a sudden we saw a spike in his pulse, so the patient obviously had something happen that brought his pulse up real high.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有些不对劲，但突然之间我们看到他的脉搏飙升，显然患者发生了什么事情导致脉搏升得很高。

sentences.text: Hey Eddie, I'll be taking your x-ray tonight.
sentences.zh: 嘿，埃迪，今晚我来给你拍X光。

sentences.text: Without buying me dinner first?
Tsk tsk, Eddie.
It's like he died and went to heaven.
sentences.zh: 就好像他死了去了天堂一样。

sentences.text: I'll leave you two to be.
I'm going to go check on some results.
So we get the x-ray shot.
I look at the chest film.
Heart size looks normal.
I don't see pneumothorax, so it's not the heart, it's not the lungs.
sentences.zh: 我没有看到气胸，所以不是心脏的问题，也不是肺的问题。

sentences.text: There's something else going on.
And then I hear this bloodcurdling scream coming from across the room.
sentences.zh: 然后我听到从房间那头传来一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。

sentences.text: YOU STAY AWAY.
STAY AWAY.
Run back and I see what's going on and the patient's quivering [snorts] in a corner, scared, almost scared to death.
sentences.zh: 我跑回去看看发生了什么，病人蜷缩在角落里发抖，害怕，几乎吓死了。

sentences.text: Ted, what's going on?
He's refusing the IV.
She's out to get me.
So while the patient is almost in tears about being stuck with an IV needle, I convince him and I reassure him that uh we're working with [music] him, not against him.
sentences.zh: 所以当病人因为要被打静脉针而几乎要哭出来时，我说服他并安慰他，我们是和他一起努力，而不是反对他。

sentences.text: >> We're trying to work with you.
We're trying to help you get better.
>> It's just a little poke.
Uh Ted Not you.
Cam Samantha's one of our best nurses and we're here to take care of you.
sentences.zh: 卡姆·萨曼莎是我们最好的护士之一，我们是来照顾你的。

sentences.text: Please let us do our job.
sentences.zh: 请让我们做好我们的工作。

sentences.text: Only if you hold my hand.
Okay.
So after coaching him to have the IV placed [music] and uh blood's coming out of the IV, she um looks up and says Oh my.
sentences.zh: 所以在我指导他完成静脉置管后，血液从静脉留置针里流出来，她抬头看了看说：“哦，天哪。”

sentences.text: Look at this.
So I look down and the blood doesn't have its usual red appearance that you would expect to find from a venous blood [music] draw, but rather the blood is brown.
sentences.zh: 于是我低头一看，血液并不是通常静脉采血时那种正常的红色，而是棕色的。

sentences.text: >> It's like chocolate syrup.
Oh.
Chocolate syrup?
Are we making sundaes?
I'm going through my Rolodex of diagnoses [music] and I'm thinking Brown-colored blood cyanotic I think there's something going on at the molecular level in his blood.
sentences.zh: 我在脑海里翻查我的诊断库，想着：棕色的血……发绀……我觉得他血液的分子层面出了问题。

sentences.text: Like the iron in his hemoglobin.
sentences.zh: 就像他血红蛋白中的铁。

sentences.text: Let's check his labs.
I'll be right back, Ted.
I'm concerned there's something going on with the iron state that's in the hemoglobin molecule that carries [music] blood.
sentences.zh: 我担心血红蛋白分子中的铁状态可能有问题，它负责携带血液中的氧气。

sentences.text: Hey, do we get those labs back yet?
sentences.zh: 嘿，那些化验结果出来了吗？

sentences.text: Thanks.
Labs all look good.
I think the arterial blood gas is going to give us a lot more information.
sentences.zh: 我认为动脉血气分析会给我们提供更多信息。

sentences.text: Let's call respiratory for an ABG stat.
sentences.zh: 叫呼吸科来做紧急动脉血气分析。

sentences.text: An arterial blood gas or an ABG will give us a a better indication as [music] to what's going on because specifically it'll show us how well or how poorly he's oxygenating his blood.
sentences.zh: 动脉血气分析或ABG能更好地指示情况，因为它能具体显示他血液氧合的好坏程度。

sentences.text: But more importantly, it'll give us a level of methemoglobin that you wouldn't find in a venous [music] blood draw.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，它能提供静脉血样中无法检测到的高铁血红蛋白水平。

sentences.text: In the case of an arterial blood gas or ABG, we need to get blood from an arterial source.
sentences.zh: 对于动脉血气分析或ABG，我们需要从动脉来源获取血液。

sentences.text: Which patient?
The blue guy in bed two.
You can't miss him.
Yoo-hoo.
So, we get the ABG, the respiratory technician runs back.
sentences.zh: 我们做了动脉血气分析，呼吸技师跑回来。

sentences.text: Hey, Dr. B, you're absolutely right.
His methemoglobin's off the charts, up near 50%.
sentences.zh: 他的高铁血红蛋白水平高得离谱，接近50%。

sentences.text: Bingo, I got the diagnosis.
Now I got to treat him.
Yeah, good luck.
>> Thanks.
What is it?
Methemoglobinemia.
Let's start 120 mg of methylene blue IV right away.
sentences.zh: 立即开始静脉注射120毫克亚甲蓝。

sentences.text: You got it.

>> Methylene blue [music] is this brilliantly blue-colored dye that's uh administered uh in addition to normal saline IV goes directly into the vein and that helps change the hemoglobin molecule back to its normal state where it can adequately
sentences.zh: 亚甲蓝[音乐]是一种亮蓝色的染料，除了生理盐水静脉注射外，它直接进入静脉，帮助血红蛋白分子恢复到正常状态，使其能够充分

sentences.text: carry oxygen to the rest of the body.
sentences.zh: 将氧气输送到身体其他部位。

sentences.text: This is something I've read about, but I've never actually seen this.
sentences.zh: 这是我读到过的东西，但我从未真正见过。

sentences.text: If it isn't Nurse Smiley and Dr. Dreamy.
sentences.zh: 这不是微笑护士和梦幻医生吗。

sentences.text: Hello, Ted.
>> What's that?
This is methylene blue.
There's been an alteration of the hemoglobin molecules of your red blood cells.
sentences.zh: 你红细胞中的血红蛋白分子发生了改变。

sentences.text: What in my whaticles?
There's basically a molecular change in the hemoglobin molecules of your red blood cells.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你红细胞中的血红蛋白分子发生了分子变化。

sentences.text: These are responsible for carrying oxygen to the rest of your body.
sentences.zh: 这些分子负责将氧气输送到身体其他部位。

sentences.text: This is why your skin is blue and your blood is brown.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你的皮肤是蓝色的，而你的血液是棕色的。

sentences.text: This methylene blue will help recalibrate your hemoglobin molecules back to normal so that you can transport oxygen to the rest of your body better and you can be more normal.
sentences.zh: 这种亚甲蓝将帮助你的血红蛋白分子重新校准回正常状态，这样你就能更好地将氧气输送到身体其他部位，从而变得更正常。

sentences.text: I have no idea what you just said.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道你刚才说了什么。

sentences.text: We have a solution.
So, we get the uh methylene blue hung.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们把亚甲蓝挂上。

sentences.text: Patient is mesmerized by this blue.
sentences.zh: 病人被这种蓝色迷住了。

sentences.text: It's a brilliant blue, brilliant turquoise blue, almost a blue that you would see in Bora Bora.
sentences.zh: 这是一种亮蓝色，亮蓝绿色，几乎是在波拉波拉岛才能看到的蓝色。

sentences.text: Wait.
I'm blue.
And you're putting blue in me.
sentences.zh: 而且你把蓝色注入我体内。

sentences.text: How is that going to fix me?
Will I always be blue?
No, Ted.
Ted.
Ted.
It's okay, Ted.
We're going to help you out.
He wasn't belligerent, but it was just he was scared.
So, my job was to reassure him and just make sure that everybody keeps calm and even the patient keeps calm.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的工作是安抚他，确保每个人都保持冷静，甚至病人也保持冷静。

sentences.text: You know what would really calm me down?
sentences.zh: 你知道什么能真正让我冷静下来吗？

sentences.text: >> What's that, Ted?
And I hope this treatment works fast because until then, I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 我希望这种治疗能快点起效，因为在那之前，我哪儿也不去。

sentences.text: I'm already feeling less blue.
sentences.zh: 我已经感觉不那么忧郁了。

sentences.text: Took a long time, [music] uh a lot of hand-holding and a lot of reassurance.
sentences.zh: 花了很长时间，[音乐] 呃，很多手把手的安抚和很多 reassurance。

sentences.text: A little bit of time goes by and You're pink.
I should hope so.
Pink complexion, um pink lips, and he's also sobering up at this point.
sentences.zh: 粉红色的肤色，嗯，粉红色的嘴唇，而且他此时正在清醒过来。

sentences.text: >> How are you feeling?
>> [sighs] >> Like I could use a bubble bath.
sentences.zh: （叹气）就像我可以泡个泡泡浴。

sentences.text: We were pretty worried about you last night, Ted.
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚很担心你，泰德。

sentences.text: Did you do anything last night, Ted, that you might not have done in the past, anything out of the ordinary?
sentences.zh: 泰德，你昨晚有没有做过什么你以前可能没做过的事情，有什么不寻常的吗？

sentences.text: Did you ingest anything?
I'm kind of embarrassed.
Uh the patient [music] kind of looks down and says, I went out last night with some friends.
sentences.zh: 嗯，病人（音乐）有点低下头说，我昨晚和一些朋友出去了。

sentences.text: Partied a little too much, I guess.
Some friends, they >> [sighs and gasps] >> they wanted me to try something I'd never tried before.
sentences.zh: 一些朋友，他们（叹气并喘气）他们想让我尝试一些我以前从未尝试过的东西。

sentences.text: They were called poppers.
Poppers are um amyl nitrite packs that are commonly found in the uh cyanide [music] toxicity kit.
sentences.zh: Poppers 是亚硝酸戊酯包，通常见于氰化物中毒急救包中。

sentences.text: They give the patient a feeling of uh euphoria if used [music] inappropriately, uh it can be severely detrimental to one's health.
sentences.zh: 如果使用不当，它们会给患者带来欣快感，但可能严重损害健康。

sentences.text: Poppers.
What that does is when you inhale that, that can change the hemoglobin molecule in the red blood cells to a state that [music] can't carry oxygen as well to the rest of your tissues.
sentences.zh: 当你吸入它时，它会改变红细胞中的血红蛋白分子，使其无法像正常那样将氧气输送到身体其他组织。

sentences.text: This can lead to cyanosis.
This is why your skin was blue and the blood was brown.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你的皮肤发蓝、血液呈棕色。

sentences.text: The methylene blue that we gave you helps change the hemoglobin back to its normal state so it can better deliver oxygen to the rest of your body again.
sentences.zh: 我们给你的亚甲蓝有助于将血红蛋白恢复至正常状态，使其能再次更好地将氧气输送到身体其他部位。

sentences.text: Does that make any sense?
Do you want my honest answer, Doc?
So, I guess his body just [music] didn't know how it would how it would react to um having taken it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想他的身体只是不知道会如何反应。

sentences.text: And um he was embarrassed and he admitted.
[music] He said, "Hey, Doc, I overdid it.
Um I probably shouldn't have done it."
sentences.zh: 嗯，我可能不应该这么做。

sentences.text: You got to be careful out there, Ted.
sentences.zh: 你在外面要小心点，泰德。

sentences.text: I'm just glad you're feeling better.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你感觉好些了。

sentences.text: Thank you, Doc.
My pleasure.
Really, thank you.
Did I do anything embarrassing while I was on that stuff?
sentences.zh: 我吃那药的时候有没有做什么尴尬的事？

sentences.text: I feel so red in the face.
Red in the face would have been a lot easier to deal with, but no.
sentences.zh: 脸红倒还好处理，但你没有。

sentences.text: I wouldn't say you did anything to be too ashamed of.
sentences.zh: 我不会说你做了什么太丢人的事。

sentences.text: Don't forget your phone.
You don't want to lose those pictures.
Oh, no.
We need a doctor's statement, doctor's statement, please.
sentences.zh: 我们需要医生的声明，请提供医生的声明。

sentences.text: Hey.
That's what I mean.
Now, see, that smile does really make your nails pop.
sentences.zh: 你看，那个笑容确实让你的指甲更显眼。

sentences.text: >> [laughter] >> Thank you.
Take it easy out there.
Feel better, Ted.
It was a crazy Saturday night, but after all is said and done, it's one that I am sure I won't forget.
sentences.zh: 那是一个疯狂的周六夜晚，但归根结底，我相信这是我不会忘记的一个夜晚。

sentences.zh: 大家好，我是斯潘格勒医生。

sentences.text: This is Jonathan.
Call me Johnny.
I got fish hook in my leg.
All right, well, put him in two, guys.
sentences.zh: 好的，把他抬到二号床，伙计们。

sentences.text: I'll be right there.
I can smell the booze from here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里都能闻到酒味。

sentences.text: Yeah, he's not feeling any pain, that's for sure.
sentences.zh: 是啊，他肯定感觉不到疼。

sentences.text: His vital signs were fine.
The nurses were starting an IV.
sentences.zh: 护士们正在给他打静脉输液。

sentences.text: Hello, sir.
So, you were out fishing?
Nah, I was drinking.
Well, my experience, there aren't too many fish hooks in bars.
sentences.zh: 以我的经验，酒吧里可没那么多鱼钩。

sentences.text: And uh after talking with my buddies, I figured I'd go check out the lines I set, and that's when I got caught.
sentences.zh: 呃，和朋友们聊完后，我想去看看我下的线，结果就被钩住了。

sentences.text: All right, let's let's take a look.
Woah!
He had a giant and I mean giant fish hook impaled in his leg.
sentences.zh: 他的腿上刺着一个巨大的——我是说巨大的——鱼钩。

sentences.text: I mean, it looked like Paul Bunyan went fishing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，看起来就像保罗·班扬去钓鱼了一样。

sentences.text: That is a very large hook.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常大的钩子。

sentences.text: This thing was a good foot, foot and a half in length.
sentences.zh: 这个东西足足有一英尺、一英尺半长。

sentences.text: So, what were you fishing for, Johnny?
sentences.zh: 那么，约翰尼，你在钓什么？

sentences.text: A whale?
No.

sentences.zh: 看看她手机里能找到什么。

sentences.text: I love my nurses.
They're like having in-house detectives.
sentences.zh: 他们就像有内部侦探一样。

sentences.text: Wait, what are you doing with my phone?
sentences.zh: 等等，你拿我手机干什么？

sentences.text: Just trying to find a family member to contact.
sentences.zh: 只是想找个家人联系一下。

sentences.text: >> No.
No, you can't call anyone.
sentences.zh: 不，你不能打电话给任何人。

sentences.text: Put it back.
Sure, Emily.
They'll find out what's going on.
sentences.zh: 他们会查明发生了什么。

sentences.text: I realize that contacting her family is a risk because she doesn't want me to, but I put the patient's welfare first.
sentences.zh: 我意识到联系她的家人有风险，因为她不想让我这么做，但我把病人的安危放在首位。

sentences.text: What's that beeping?
Her O2 sats are dropping, Greg.
sentences.zh: 她的血氧饱和度在下降，格雷格。

sentences.text: Let's get some oxygen on her.
Put a mask on with 10 L.
Her oxygen level is dropping.
Her pulse is getting slower.
I'm worried something very bad is about to happen.
sentences.zh: 我担心很快会有非常糟糕的事情发生。

sentences.text: Doc, I got a hold of her father, and he's on his way.
sentences.zh: 医生，我联系上了她的父亲，他正在路上。

sentences.text: Her dad's coming here?
You know him?
Not very well.
Anyway, I have to go now.
My boyfriend's waiting for me.
The friend took off.
I guess she just didn't want to be involved anymore.
sentences.zh: 我猜她只是不想再牵扯进来了。

sentences.text: She's having PVCs.
PVCs means premature ventricular contractions.
sentences.zh: PVCs 的意思是室性早搏。

sentences.text: That means an irritated heart.
A heart that's liable [music] to go into a lethal arrhythmia or stop beating completely.
sentences.zh: 一颗容易进入致命性心律失常或完全停止跳动的心脏。

sentences.text: That means we now have a failing heart.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们现在有一个衰竭的心脏。

sentences.text: It's confusing the hell out of me.
Not knowing what else to do, I ordered another EKG.
sentences.zh: 不知道还能做什么，我又安排了一次心电图。

sentences.text: Let me see it.
The waves on the EKG machine are named A, B, C, D.
sentences.zh: 心电图机上的波被命名为A、B、C、D。

sentences.text: Look at this.
She's got U waves.
[music] The EKG has something extra on it, an extra wave.
sentences.zh: [音乐] 心电图上多了一点东西，一个额外的波。

sentences.text: Definitely has U waves.
Nothing else causes an extra wave on the EKG or U wave except low potassium.
sentences.zh: 除了低钾，没有其他原因会导致心电图上出现额外的波或U波。

sentences.text: Malnutrition leads to low potassium.
Low potassium can stop the heart from working and cause [music] cardiac arrest.
sentences.zh: 低钾会使心脏停止工作，并导致[音乐]心脏骤停。

sentences.text: Greg, I need those labs right now.
sentences.zh: 格雷格，我现在就需要那些化验结果。

sentences.text: Get the crash cart and call respiratory.
sentences.zh: 把急救车推过来，叫呼吸科。

sentences.text: On it.
Without the lab work and knowing her actual potassium level, it's extremely dangerous for me to administer potassium.
sentences.zh: 没有化验结果，不知道她的实际血钾水平，给我补钾是极其危险的。

sentences.text: Oh, hi.
You're Hank.
You're her father?
What happened to my daughter?
She looks like she's chronically malnourished.
sentences.zh: 她看起来像是长期营养不良。

sentences.text: Yeah, tell me something I don't know.
The father sounded bitter.
He's had a tough time with her trying to get her to eat and take care of herself.
sentences.zh: 他为了让她吃饭和照顾自己，一直过得很艰难。

sentences.text: She's really sick, huh?
I'm afraid so.
What can you tell me about her past medical history?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我她过去的病史吗？

sentences.text: Uh, she was healthy before her mom passed a couple of years ago, but uh then she changed.
sentences.zh: 呃，她妈妈几年前去世前她一直很健康，但之后她就变了。

sentences.text: Stopped eating, started dressing in black, turning to someone I didn't even recognize anymore.
sentences.zh: 不吃饭，开始穿黑衣服，变成了我都不认识的人。

sentences.text: Then quit school and ran away.
I tried to help, but uh Emily was always closer to her mom.
sentences.zh: 我试图帮忙，但艾米丽总是和她妈妈更亲近。

sentences.text: I looked at the monitor.
Her blood pressure and her pulse had dropped to dangerously low levels.
sentences.zh: 她的血压和脉搏已经降到了危险的低水平。

sentences.text: I have to do something.
If her potassium level is low as I think it is, and I don't give her potassium, her heart will stop and she will die.
sentences.zh: 如果她的血钾水平像我猜的那样低，而我不给她补钾，她的心脏就会停止跳动，她会死。

sentences.text: If her potassium level is normal and I give her potassium, her heart may stop and she'll die.
sentences.zh: 如果她的血钾水平正常而我给她补钾，她的心脏可能会停止跳动，她会死。

sentences.text: But I have to do something.
Labs?
Not ready yet, Dr. Bob.
This is a life or death situation.
Do I wait for the labs and risk her heart stopping because she doesn't have enough potassium, or do I administer a mega dose of potassium and risk stopping [music] her heart?
sentences.zh: 我是等待化验结果，冒着她的心脏因缺钾而停跳的风险，还是给她大剂量钾，冒着心脏停跳的风险？

sentences.text: We're going to give IV potassium.
I want you to mix up 10 mEq of potassium in 50 cc's of saline.
sentences.zh: 我要你把10毫当量的钾溶于50毫升生理盐水中。

sentences.text: We're going to run it in over 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们将在10分钟内输注完毕。

sentences.text: Are you sure?
I've made my decision.
I'm going with it.
Go ahead, run it in.
Potassium is paradoxical.
>> [music] >> If it's too low, your heart will stop.
sentences.zh: 如果它太低，你的心脏会停止。

sentences.text: If it's too high, your heart will stop.
sentences.zh: 如果它太高，你的心脏也会停止。

sentences.text: >> [music] >> So, we infuse 10 mEq of potassium as fast as possible and I hope for the best.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们尽可能快地输注10毫当量的钾，并希望得到最好的结果。

sentences.text: No change yet.
Labs are up.
Either I've just saved Emily's life or I've ended it.
sentences.zh: 要么我刚刚救了艾米丽的命，要么我结束了它。

sentences.text: We're about to find out which.
sentences.zh: 我们马上就要知道是哪种情况了。

sentences.text: Thank god.
Her potassium is 2.2.
I was right.
As the potassium infused, [music] I saw her EKG narrow and came back to normal.
sentences.zh: 随着钾的输注，我看到她的心电图变窄并恢复正常。

sentences.text: What are you doing here?
She's getting better.
We've avoided a cardiac arrest, but if she continues malnourished, her life is in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 我们避免了心脏骤停，但如果她继续营养不良，她的生命将处于危险之中。

sentences.text: I love you Emily.
Sorry I haven't been the best father to have, but I'm here to take care of you now.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我一直不是最好的父亲，但现在我来照顾你了。

sentences.text: You don't have to take care of me.
I'm dead.
You should just bury me.
Oh babe.
Please stop saying stuff like that.
Can't you do something to make her stop saying she's dead?
sentences.zh: 你能不能做点什么让她别再说她死了？

sentences.text: Hank, let me talk to you a minute.
I can't do anything else for her till I figure out what's really going on.
sentences.zh: 在我弄清楚到底发生了什么之前，我无法为她做任何其他事情。

sentences.text: Has she ever had an eating disorder?
sentences.zh: 她曾经有过饮食失调吗？

sentences.text: >> No.
No.
No.
She doesn't eat cuz she thinks she's dead.
sentences.zh: 她不吃东西，因为她觉得自己死了。

sentences.text: She really thinks she's dead, huh?
sentences.zh: 她真的觉得自己死了，是吗？

sentences.text: Has she seen a psychiatrist?
>> Oh yeah.
They They gave us some bull about her having a rare condition where people really think they're dead.
sentences.zh: 他们给了我们一些废话，说她有一种罕见的疾病，人们真的认为自己死了。

sentences.text: They call it a condition?
Yep.
Yep.
Sounds dumb, right?
Did they give Emily's illness a name?
sentences.zh: 他们给艾米丽的病起了名字吗？

sentences.text: Yeah.
Uh it was something like uh sounded like a zombie movie.
sentences.zh: 呃，听起来有点像僵尸电影里的东西。

sentences.text: Uh what the heck was it called?
Uh Walking Corpse Syndrome.
Walking Corpse Syndrome?
Every doctor has that moment where they say, "What the hell?
sentences.zh: 每个医生都有那么一刻，他们会说：“搞什么鬼？

sentences.text: Now what do I do?"
I needed to learn more about this.
sentences.zh: 我需要了解更多关于这个的信息。

sentences.text: Sure enough, on the internet I learned that this is a very rare psychiatric condition called [music] Cotard's Syndrome that occurs mostly in young females.
sentences.zh: 果然，我在网上了解到这是一种非常罕见的精神疾病，叫做科塔尔综合征，主要发生在年轻女性身上。

sentences.text: The Cotard's patients have a delusion that they're dead.
sentences.zh: 科塔尔综合征患者有一种妄想，认为自己已经死了。

sentences.text: They really believe they're dead.
sentences.zh: 他们真的相信自己已经死了。

sentences.text: Treatment includes therapy and antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 治疗包括心理治疗和抗抑郁药。

sentences.text: I learned that some of these patients actually commit suicide.
sentences.zh: 我了解到这些患者中有些人确实会自杀。

sentences.text: For example, jumping off a building thinking it won't harm them because they're already dead.
sentences.zh: 例如，从建筑物跳下，认为这不会伤害他们，因为他们已经死了。

sentences.text: The major cause of death is malnutrition with electrolyte imbalance.
sentences.zh: 主要的死亡原因是营养不良伴随电解质失衡。

sentences.text: That's what I'm worried about with Emily.
sentences.zh: 这正是我担心艾米丽的地方。

sentences.text: After the saline and potassium had kicked in, Emily was a lot more alert.
sentences.zh: 在生理盐水和钾起效后，艾米丽清醒多了。

sentences.text: >> Leave me alone.
I I don't want your help.
>> You have to eat Emily.
Not eating's what made you sick.
sentences.zh: 不吃东西才让你生病的。

sentences.text: >> I'm not sick.
I'm dead.
Well, hang on, honey.
I'm leaving.
I'm 18 now.
You can't keep me here.
>> Well, he can force you to stay here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他可以强迫你留在这里。

sentences.text: Her father wanted me to hold her against her will, but because she was 18, she had the right to leave.
sentences.zh: 她父亲想让我违背她的意愿留住她，但因为她已经18岁，她有权离开。

sentences.text: Emily, I'll make a deal with you.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，我跟你做个交易。

sentences.text: Eat something on that tray, and I'll discharge you.
sentences.zh: 吃点那个托盘上的东西，我就让你出院。

sentences.text: Fine.
After you get these tubes out of my body.
sentences.zh: 等我把这些管子从身体里拔出来之后。

sentences.text: Hank, let me talk to you a minute.
sentences.zh: 汉克，让我跟你谈一分钟。

sentences.text: Hank, she must see a psychiatrist.
sentences.zh: 汉克，她必须去看精神科医生。

sentences.text: I'm giving you the contact information here of the best one I know.
sentences.zh: 我给你我认识的最好的精神科医生的联系方式。

sentences.text: Make sure she sees him.
See, it doesn't hurt to eat.
Can I leave now?
I just need your signature confirming that you're leaving against medical advice.
sentences.zh: 我只需要你签字确认你是违背医嘱离开的。

sentences.text: I signed her out AMA, and I finally got her to agree to go [music] see a psychiatrist for further evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我让她签署了AMA（违背医嘱离开），并最终说服她同意去看精神科医生做进一步评估。

sentences.text: I was very concerned that she would die if she didn't get help.
sentences.zh: 我非常担心如果她不接受帮助会死掉。

sentences.text: So, as she departed, I was wondering, was I going to see her back in the ER again?
sentences.zh: 所以，当她离开时，我在想，我还会在急诊室再次见到她吗？

sentences.text: About a week later, I got my answer.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，我得到了答案。

sentences.text: Hank.
What's going on?
I was stunned to see Emily innovated and lying dead still on the bed.
sentences.zh: 我震惊地看到艾米丽创新地躺在床上，一动不动。

sentences.text: Okay, stop.
I'm calling the code.
There was no cardiac activity on the monitor.
sentences.zh: 监护仪上没有心脏活动。

sentences.text: My colleague had called [music] the code.
sentences.zh: 我的同事已经宣布了急救代码。

sentences.text: It looked like Emily had really died this time.
sentences.zh: 看起来艾米丽这次真的死了。

sentences.text: Start bagging.
Bob, it's no use.
I've done everything.
sentences.zh: 我已经做了所有能做的。

sentences.text: I've pushed the Epi, I pushed the vasopressin.
sentences.zh: 我推注了肾上腺素，推注了血管加压素。

sentences.text: My colleague told me I was wasting my time.
sentences.zh: 我的同事告诉我我在浪费时间。

sentences.text: He'd done everything.
Nothing worked.
She was dead.
But I knew the most likely cause of death in this patient was cardiac arrest cuz I had previously treated her.
sentences.zh: 但我知道这名患者最可能的死因是心脏骤停，因为我之前治疗过她。

sentences.text: I knew something he didn't know.
sentences.zh: 我知道一些他不知道的事。

sentences.text: Did you give potassium?
No.
10 milliequivalents of potassium IV stat, please.
sentences.zh: 请立即静脉注射10毫当量的钾。

sentences.text: I said bag her.
Bob, have you lost your mind?
She's dead.
The girl's not dead till I say she's dead, Rich.
sentences.zh: 在我宣布她死之前，这女孩就没死，里奇。

sentences.text: Well, best of luck.
I just couldn't accept the death of an 18-year-old girl who's potentially salvageable.
sentences.zh: 我就是无法接受一个18岁女孩的死亡，她还有可能救活。

sentences.text: Let's give her 40 mg of vasopressin IV, please.
sentences.zh: 请给她静脉注射40毫克加压素。

sentences.text: We gave her every drug we had to try to [music] jump-start the heart.
sentences.zh: 我们给她用了所有能用的药，试图让心脏重新跳动。

sentences.text: They all kept looking at me.
They wanted to call the code, but I wasn't giving up.
sentences.zh: 他们想宣布死亡时间，但我不放弃。

sentences.text: She's got pupillary function.
Her pupils were still reactive.
That meant that her brain was still working.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她的大脑还在工作。

sentences.text: Come on, Emily.
This is a savable patient.
sentences.zh: 这是一个可以救活的病人。

sentences.text: There's cardiac activity.
Yeah, okay.
Stop compressions.
Let's check for pulse.
I got a pulse.
I got a pulse.
And there was a bounding pulse.
I breathed a big [music] sigh of relief.
We got her back, Hank.
sentences.zh: 我们把她救回来了，汉克。

sentences.text: It wasn't her time.
[music] It wasn't her time.
It's a miracle we got her back.
sentences.zh: 我们能救回她真是个奇迹。

sentences.text: It's a miracle.
Bob, I I thought she was gone, man.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃，我，我以为她走了，老兄。

sentences.text: I'll be honest with you, I thought [music] she was gone, too.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我也以为她走了。

sentences.text: Sometimes it's good to lose your mind a little bit.
sentences.zh: 有时候稍微失去理智是件好事。

sentences.text: I got lucky, Rich.
I got lucky.
>> Good job.
We admitted her to the ICU and she was discharged the next day, but her problems weren't over.
sentences.zh: 我们把她收治进ICU，她第二天就出院了，但她的问题还没结束。

sentences.text: She still had Cotard syndrome [music] and would most likely end up back in the ER again.
sentences.zh: 她仍然患有科塔尔综合征，很可能最终又会回到急诊室。

sentences.text: Dr. Bob, there's someone in the waiting room for [music] you.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃医生，有人在候诊室找你。

sentences.text: Who?
Hmm, you'll be surprised.
All right.
I went out to the waiting room.
There was Hank and Emily.
She looked like a different person.
sentences.zh: 她看起来像变了一个人。

sentences.text: [music] She looked healthy.
My gosh, look at you.
You look fabulous.
Can I give you a hug?
You bet.
We've been seeing your [music] shrink friend.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在看你的[音乐]心理医生朋友。

sentences.text: That's great.
That's great.
I'm feeling a lot better now.
It's true.
She's like [music] a whole new person.
sentences.zh: 她就像[音乐]一个全新的人。

sentences.text: Fabulous.
You guys have made my day.
During a summer heat wave, Dr. Kathleen Klem's ER is overflowing and the AC just went out.
sentences.zh: 在夏季热浪期间，Kathleen Klem医生的急诊室人满为患，空调又坏了。

sentences.text: Any news?
It's the compressor, apparently.
They're changing [music] it now, but it's going to take a couple hours or more.
sentences.zh: 他们正在[音乐]更换，但需要几个小时或更长时间。

sentences.text: Great.
An August heat wave and a broken air conditioning system Could you plug that in over there for us?
sentences.zh: 八月的热浪和坏掉的空调系统——你能帮我们把那个插到那边吗？

sentences.text: are a terrible combination in the ER.
sentences.zh: 在急诊室里是可怕的组合。

sentences.text: These patients are going to need some ice packs and some spray bottles.
sentences.zh: 这些病人需要一些冰袋和喷雾瓶。

sentences.text: And could you get some cold drinks for these guys?
sentences.zh: 你能给这些家伙拿些冷饮吗？

sentences.text: Yep.
Thanks.
Emergency.
It was one of the hottest days on record when we got the call.
sentences.zh: 我们接到电话那天是有记录以来最热的日子之一。

sentences.text: Police were bringing in a patient in handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 警察正带着一名戴着手铐的病人进来。

sentences.text: They're going to be here in 5 minutes.
Get him a bed.
According to the police, they found a man in the park wearing nothing but shoes and underwear.
sentences.zh: 据警方称，他们在公园里发现一名男子，只穿着鞋和内裤。

sentences.text: It's going to be the room right there.
Any information, any history on the patient?
sentences.zh: 有什么信息吗？病人的病史？

sentences.text: No.
Can you please hurry?
soon as another treatment bay opens up, we'll get you situated.
sentences.zh: 等另一个治疗区一空出来，我们就安顿你。

sentences.text: >> Thank you.
All right.
Knock knock.
Hi, Jeffrey.
I'm Dr. Clem.
How are you feeling?
His hair was a little bit disheveled.
I could tell he was afraid.
Why don't I have you come sit down on the bed?
Think you could do that?
Yes.
He would kind of dart, look one way, and then he would look another way, but I could tell he really wanted to trust me as his doctor.
sentences.zh: 他会突然闪躲，朝一个方向看，然后又朝另一个方向看，但我能看出他真的很想信任我这个医生。

sentences.text: Jeffrey, it's my job to help you get the care that you need, [music] but to do that, I have to learn a little bit about you.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，帮助你获得所需的护理是我的工作，但要做到这一点，我必须了解你的一些情况。

sentences.text: Think you could help me with that?
Okay, are you on any medications?
sentences.zh: 好的，你在服用任何药物吗？

sentences.text: No.
Got to keep it clear up here.
Stay sharp.
Any family members?
[music] Can you give me the name of a family member?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我一个家人的名字吗？

sentences.text: Makes it more difficult for all of us to care for a patient if we really don't have any idea of what their support network is, where they live, where they came from.
sentences.zh: 如果我们完全不了解患者的支持网络、他们住在哪里、来自哪里，照顾他们会变得更加困难。

sentences.text: It's not safe.
They could be killed.
By who?
Gangsters.
I'm going to run for president, but you see, they don't want me to be president, so they might assassinate me.
sentences.zh: 我要竞选总统，但你看，他们不想让我当总统，所以他们可能会暗杀我。

sentences.text: He was just so honest and straightforward, and >> [music] >> and really, truly expected that I would believe that the mafia was after him.
sentences.zh: 他非常诚实直率，而且 >> [音乐] >> 真的，真心地认为我会相信黑手党在追杀他。

sentences.text: I'm not only running for president, I'm also running for my life.
sentences.zh: 我不仅是在竞选总统，我还在逃命。
